title: The Historic building in the square
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：historic　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 historic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the keeper wrote of ① a historic building in the square in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② so historic that nobody in the tower would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the historic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the historic building in the square that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too historic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the historic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a historic visit of the delegates, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as historic as the visit of the delegates they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was historic or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something historic, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite historic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the historic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, in the rain, she wrote of another historic building in the square in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less historic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The historic visit of the delegates that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the historic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有历史意义（前置定语 a historic building in the square：1965 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件有历史意义的历史建筑）
B. adj. 有历史意义／史上有名（两处加强说法：so historic that … 与 no less historic than …）
C. adj. 有历史意义／史上有名（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有历史意义（表语 too historic to do：母亲觉得它太有历史意义，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 史上有名（前置定语 a historic visit of the delegates：叔叔把整件事称作一桩史上有名的访问）
F. adj. 史上有名（同级比较 as historic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩代表团那次载入史册的访问相比）
G. adj. 史上有名（后置定语 something historic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 史上有名（受程度副词修饰 quite historic：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a historic building in the square
the historic building in the square that
a historic visit of the delegates
The historic visit of the delegates that

answers.why: historic 意为“有历史意义”，1965 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件有历史意义的历史建筑”，此处作前置定语 a historic building in the square。
historic 意为“有历史意义”，此处用 so historic that 结构，说它有历史意义到钟楼里没人敢靠近。
historic 意为“有历史意义”，年历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的有历史意义广场上的历史建筑，等于最高级的说法。
historic 意为“有历史意义”，母亲认为这件东西“太有历史意义了，谁也用不上”，too historic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
historic 意为“史上有名”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩史上有名的访问”，此处作前置定语 a historic visit of the delegates。
historic 意为“史上有名”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩代表团那次载入史册的访问一样史上有名”，同级比较用 as historic as。
historic 意为“史上有名”，年历上那半行字要的是“史上有名的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something historic。
historic 意为“史上有名”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当史上有名”，quite 修饰原级 historic。
historic 意为“史上有名”，no less historic than 表示“其史上有名不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之史上有名不亚于任何人的预料。
historic 意为“史上有名”，母亲 1977 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的史上有名访问”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件有历史意义的历史建筑。（a historic building in the square）
它有历史意义到钟楼里没有一个人敢靠近。（so historic that …）
母亲觉得它太有历史意义，谁也用不上。（too historic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩史上有名的访问。（a historic visit of the delegates）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩代表团那次载入史册的访问一样史上有名。（as historic as …）
到了 1972 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件史上有名的东西。（something historic）
answers: In 1965 the keeper wrote of a historic building in the square in the calendar.
It was so historic that nobody in the tower would go near it.
My mother thought it too historic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a historic visit of the delegates.
He said nobody would call it as historic as the visit of the delegates they had once had.
By 1972 the calendar asked for nothing but something historic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 historic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the keeper wrote of a historic building in the square in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the historic building in the square that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too historic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a historic visit of the delegates, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite historic, and everybody laughed.
The historic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
